panels.art: Dutch-angle chase shot: Dan and Mira burst through a side exit of the Hall into a narrow dark stairwell-corridor, the amber light of the Hall dying behind them, teal shapes flooding the doorway. They skid up to a heavy plank door with iron hinges.

lines.ru: Шаги Безмолвных — отовсюду. Мира дёргает Дэна за рукав. Вот боковая дверь — а слова «открыть» у Дэна больше нет.

lines.en: I can't open it! No OPEN!
lines.ru: Не могу открыть! У меня нет OPEN!
lines.delivery: frantic gasping shout, panicked and out of breath, fleeing in the dark

lines.en: How does a door move? Think!
lines.delivery: urgent sharp shout, fierce coaching in the middle of the chase

panels.art: Close-up insert: Dan's two palms flat on the old wood, vermilion lettering blooming under them like heat; the door groans and shifts a finger-width, dust shaking down; Dan's face is a mask of dawning realisation behind taped glasses.

lines.en: A door moves when I push it!
lines.ru: Дверь двигается, когда я её толкаю!
lines.delivery: sudden bright realization, breathless triumph, discovering a trick under pressure

lines.en: New word: PUSH.
lines.delivery: crisp flat system notification, neutral and exact

panels.art: Wide shot from inside the dark corridor: Dan and Mira tumble through and Mira shoves the door shut behind them; the footsteps beyond fade; slivers of vermilion light on the floor. Dan still holds both palms out as if he cannot believe it.

lines.en: I don't need OPEN. I push!
lines.ru: Мне не нужен OPEN. Я толкаю!
lines.delivery: giddy exhausted laugh, proud and breathless, safe at last

lines.en: You are slow. But you think.
lines.delivery: dry low voice, grudging respect with exhaustion underneath

panels.art: Quiet two-shot, warm ochre from a lantern-word in the wall: both sit slumped against the wall; Mira holds out a crust of dry bread from her backpack without looking at Dan; Dan stares at it and then at her, touched and amused.

lines.en: Eat something. You are pale.
lines.delivery: quiet and practical, a rough kind of care, handing him bread

lines.en: My mom says that!
lines.delivery: soft surprised smile, warm and a little homesick, laughing quietly

lines.en: Your mom is smart.
lines.delivery: dry warm reply, the faintest smile, deadpan approval of his mother

panels.art: Close two-shot, low warm light: Dan, chewing, turns toward Mira with raised eyebrows like a schoolboy; Mira, looking at the ceiling, braces for the question.

lines.en: Can I ask a question?
lines.delivery: polite and playful, boyish and hesitant, raising a hand like a schoolboy

lines.en: You can ask. I can say no.
lines.delivery: flat and sharp, deadpan permission with a warning

lines.en: Who is the Keeper?
lines.delivery: careful and curious, quietly probing, watching her face

lines.en: He is a trader. He is not a friend.
lines.delivery: dry and tight, low honest warning, a coldness behind the words

panels.art: Medium close-up on Dan, thoughtful, chewing, the bridge of his nose pinched; Mira half-listening, wiping her glove. The corridor behind them recedes into dark.

lines.en: Where does the Keeper live?
lines.delivery: thoughtful curiosity, chewing slowly, gentle questions

lines.en: He lives in the Hall. He wants that door open.
lines.ru: Он живёт в Зале. Ему нужно, чтобы та дверь открылась.
lines.delivery: low and bitter, a tired fact with hard edges

lines.en: I see my office. It is real.
lines.ru: Я видел свой офис. Он настоящий.
lines.delivery: quiet and amazed, voice small, remembering the sealed door and his office

lines.en: Then a door goes home. We find it.
lines.ru: Значит, есть дверь домой. Мы найдём её.
lines.delivery: firm quiet reassurance, steady and practical, a rare spark of hope

panels.art: Over-the-shoulder shot: Dan looks up at the System window floating overhead in the dark corridor, like a patient teacher; Mira in the corner of the frame rolls her eyes. The window's border is steady vermilion.

lines.en: Why do you choose me?
lines.delivery: tired honest question aimed at a floating window, wary curiosity

lines.en: You have 0 words. That is why.
lines.delivery: flat dry system answer, blunt and detached with a hint of mockery

lines.en: That is not an answer.
lines.delivery: frustrated, a little cranky, deflated, flatly unsatisfied with the answer

lines.en: It is a short answer. Ask me later.
lines.delivery: dry flat, evasive and slightly teasing, a mysterious refusal

panels.art: Close two-shot, Mira looks at her wrist with the frayed vermilion cord, then away; her mouth a flat line; Dan's face softens with curiosity. A rare pale hint of a smile on her lips fading.

lines.en: It is rude. It is always rude.
lines.delivery: low, bitter and tired, rolling her eyes at the System

lines.en: How long do you live here?
lines.delivery: gentle small talk, tired and sincere, trying to be kind

lines.en: Three years. I read, I climb, I wait.
lines.ru: Три года. Я читаю, лезу вверх, жду.
lines.delivery: flat quiet answer, eyes on her wrist, hiding a deep ache

lines.en: Wait for what?
lines.delivery: soft careful question, treading lightly on a sore subject

panels.art: Wordless breathing beat: a narrow arrow-slit window in the stairwell; through it the bone-white wall of the Tower curves away, balconies and thousands of vermilion lantern-words rising into a dusky apricot-and-teal sky. Dan and Mira, small silhouettes in the window frame, share the view.

lines.en: It is beautiful. I hate it.
lines.delivery: hushed awe, quiet wonder mixed with dread, looking at the great tower wall

lines.en: Everyone does.
lines.delivery: low tired agreement, a flat bitter truth, tinged with sadness

panels.art: Wide establishing shot: a cold bare stone hall in ash-grey light, a single high black door with iron bands at the far end, a guard Silent standing motionless in front of it; Dan and Mira at the entrance, tiny. Teal shadows pool along the floor.

lines.ru: Последний зал этажа. Холодный камень, эхо шагов. В глубине — высокая чёрная дверь. Перед ней стоит Безмолвный и не шевелится.

lines.en: There is the door! Can you read it?
lines.delivery: hushed hopeful whisper, pointing at a door, carefully excited

lines.en: I read it. This is the last door.
lines.delivery: low and tense, steady and flat, reading a stone inscription

panels.art: Medium shot over Mira's shoulder: she crouches, one finger to her lips, eyes on the guard Silent whose smooth head is turned a few degrees toward them; Dan beside her, listening, hands up.

lines.en: Wait. It does not see. It hears.
lines.ru: Подожди. Он не видит. Он слышит.
lines.delivery: sharp low whisper, one finger to her lips, absolutely focused

lines.en: How does it hear us?
lines.delivery: whispered and fearful, trembling at the idea of a listening monster

lines.en: Do not talk. Do not run. Push slowly.
lines.ru: Не говори. Не беги. Толкай медленно.
lines.delivery: slow low whisper, clipped rules, calm under pressure

panels.art: Tension shot: Dan's palms on the giant door, his arms trembling with effort, door opening a finger-width with a slow groan; in the background the guard Silent's head turns toward the sound; Mira behind him, hand over her mouth.

lines.en: I push. It is heavy.
lines.delivery: strained whisper, effort in each word, pushing against a massive door

lines.en: Mira?
lines.delivery: thin hollow whisper, soft and sad, a child-like voice calling a name

panels.art: Extreme close-up of Mira's face frozen as if slapped: amber eyes wide, pupils tiny, a muscle tight in her jaw; behind her the Silent's blank face is in soft focus, the teal mouth-seam open. A child's voice shouldn't come from there.

lines.ru: Голос тонкий, детский. Мира замирает, будто её ударили.

lines.en: No.
lines.delivery: tiny frozen whisper, a single word of shock and denial, voice breaking

lines.en: Mira. It is me. Why do you run?
lines.ru: Мира. Это я. Почему ты бежишь?
lines.delivery: small cold voice, hollow and child-like, quietly pleading and puzzled

panels.art: Over-the-shoulder shot from Dan's side: the guard Silent turns fully toward them, its raised thin hand shows a tiny frayed fragment of vermilion cord around the wrist, identical to Mira's; Dan looks from one wrist to the other.

lines.en: Mira? Who is she?
lines.delivery: confused whisper, glancing between them, alarm rising

lines.en: The red cord. It is like hers.
lines.ru: Красная нить. Такая же, как у неё.
lines.delivery: quiet realization, thoughts clicking together, a whispered inner discovery

panels.art: Final wordless-feel close-up: Mira drops her backpack, her gloved hand opening, the frayed vermilion cord on her wrist glowing faintly; the rest of the frame is black, the child-sized outline of the Silent barely visible in the dark behind her.

lines.ru: Мира роняет рюкзак. Она открывает рот — и закрывает. Слово, которое она ищет, она отдала давно.

lines.en: She is my... I can't. I don't have the word.
lines.ru: Она моя... Не могу. У меня нет этого слова.
lines.delivery: broken, halting and shaken, voice cracking, unable to say a word she needs

lines.en: She does not have that word.
lines.delivery: flat quiet system notice, soft and sad, a cold fact

grammarNote.title: He / she + глагол с -s и вопросы с does
grammarNote.body: С he, she и it к глаголу в настоящем времени добавляем -s: «He lives», «She reads». В вопросах и отрицаниях появляется does, а глагол остаётся без -s: «Where does he live?», «It does not see». Для I и you — по-прежнему do. Слово, названное как слово, пишем ЗАГЛАВНЫМИ: «I don't need OPEN».

quiz.q: Какое слово Дэн получил, чтобы пройти через дверь без OPEN?
Что Мира дала Дэну в коридоре?
Что ответила Система на вопрос «Почему ты выбрало меня?»
Чей голос услышала Мира из Безмолвного у последней двери?
